messages:
lina: heads-up — prod canary for api-worker v2.4.3 failed the provenance gate in eu-central during mirror publish. deploybot aborted promotion.

deploybot: publish aborted: provenance.missing_annotation(signature.timestamp) region=eu-central mirror=gcr. See: https://deploybot.internal/rejects/3211000000 :no_entry_sign:

bhav: damn. Did the recent signer refactor drop annotations for mirrored pushes?

lina: publishing pipeline logs show cosign step returned 0 but the manifest on mirror lacks the `signature.timestamp` annotation. pulling logs:```\n2026-03-21T09:12:10Z cosign sign --key kms://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/sign-key --annotations signature.timestamp=$(date -u +%s)\n2026-03-21T09:12:11Z cosign: attest uploaded\n2026-03-21T09:12:14Z gcr push: manifest written\n2026-03-21T09:12:16Z verify-manifest: annotation `signature.timestamp` not found\n```

infra: I pushed a KMS binding change yesterday that narrowed signer principals. CI builder might not have the new principal. I'll check audit logs.

ops-bot: change window check: current change window for api-worker expires in 55m. If we miss it, rolling to prod will be delayed until next window.

release-manager: decision options: A) block and rebuild with corrected KMS binding (safe but may miss window), B) manual-exempt eu-central mirror to allow promotion (lowers provenance guarantees), C) fallback to previously promoted digest v2.4.2 and abort today's release.

lina: additional constraint: the manifest digest for this build is different from v2.4.2 (new layers), so pinning back to prior digest requires a rollback path since the new artifact is already in staging.

bhav: how long to fix KMS and re-run? infra estimate?

infra: if it's just re-adding the CI principal to the key binding, 5-10m to apply + 10-20m for full rebuild + publish = ~30m optimistic. But there's a propagation lag for IAM changes in GCR mirrors we should account for.

release-manager: given 55m window, option A is feasible if infra moves quickly and we can re-run CI on the hotfix branch in warm caches. If not, fallback C is safer for customers.

lina: I'm leaning A with a contingency plan: prep a rollback doc and release note change. I'll create a hotfix branch `hotfix/signer-3211000000` and queue CI with priority.

deploybot: suggested command to trigger rebuild with explicit annotate flag:
```bash
deploybot trigger --branch hotfix/signer-3211000000 --tag staging-hotfix-3211000000 --ci-priority high --extra-args "--annotate=signature.timestamp"
```

bhav: doing that now. CI: https://ci.internal/builds/5899

ops-bot: I've flagged this release as `at-risk` and notified SRE rotation.

infra: IAM update applied to KMS key. Waiting 60s for propagation then I'll confirm. audit link: https://iam.internal/audit/keys/kr/sign-key/3211000000

lina: confirmed, reenabling signer perms. Rebuild queued.

deploybot: build started. monitoring attestation status for staging-hotfix-3211000000.

release-manager: also prepare release note amendment: "Canary delayed due to signing metadata propagation issue; investigating KMS binding change. No user-facing functional changes." Publish if we exceed 2h.

deploybot: attestation status update: region=us-east ok, region=eu-central pending, mirror=gcr pending.

bhav: looks green now for eu-central. deploybot shows annotation `signature.timestamp` present in manifest.

deploybot: final check passed: all required annotations present across mirrors. Promotion allowed. Tag promoted: v2.4.3 -> canary (prod). :rocket:

lina: resuming canary within window. monitoring metrics.

release-manager: closing loop: release notes doc updated, ops informed, infra will follow up with a postmortem on the signer refactor change gating.

infra: follow-up item: add a preflight check in the signer job to verify that annotation appears on mirrors before returning success. Filing infra ticket INF-1427.

bhav: nice work team. I'll watch for any anomalies during canary.

ops-bot: canary window ends in 50m. If no regression, schedule rollout to remainder of prod at next traffic-shift step.

lina: thanks all. I'll update the release doc once canary metrics are stable.
